edition.title: The World in Brief · Contextual Cloze · 16 November 2026
edition.summary_zh: 6篇原创新闻语境，18个单词填空。
edition.source_label: The Economist · 订阅邮件学习版

items.example: The treasury secretary urged Nvidia to consider an outsider as its next chief executive.
items.analysis_zh: urge someone to do something 是正式建议和施压结构，后面接宾语 Nvidia 再接不定式 to consider。财长提出的是意见，不能当成公司已经决定聘请外部人士。与 order 相比，urge 没有直接命令的法律含义。
items.cloze: The treasury secretary ______ Nvidia to consider an outsider as its next chief executive.
items.why_zh: urge someone to do something 是正式建议和施压结构，后面接宾语 Nvidia 再接不定式 to consider。

imitation.background_zh: 交付协调：要求供应商重新评估计划。
imitation.sentence_en: We urged the supplier to revise its delivery plan.
imitation.translation_zh: 我们敦促供应商修订交付计划。

items.example: A campaign for Jensen Huang's return has gathered momentum among prominent technology executives.
items.analysis_zh: gather momentum 是固定搭配，表示行动获得更多支持并逐渐增强声势。has gathered 用现在完成时，将之前开始的活动与现在的影响联系起来。与 accelerate 相比，它侧重支持的累积，并不必然意味着可测量的速度变化。
items.cloze: A campaign for Jensen Huang's return has ______ momentum among prominent technology executives.
items.why_zh: gather momentum 是固定搭配，表示行动获得更多支持并逐渐增强声势。

imitation.background_zh: 生活安排：朋友们逐渐支持一次摄影旅行。
imitation.sentence_en: The idea of a weekend photography trip has gathered momentum among our friends.
imitation.translation_zh: 周末摄影旅行的想法在朋友中获得了越来越多的支持。

items.example: Reports of discussions with confidants remain unconfirmed by Nvidia, ahead of its earnings release.
items.analysis_zh: remain unconfirmed 是 remain 加形容词化过去分词的结构，强调报道尚缺公司正式确认。与 false 不同，unconfirmed 不意味着消息已经证伪；ahead of 指财报发布之前。
items.cloze: Reports of discussions with confidants remain ______ by Nvidia, ahead of its earnings release.
items.why_zh: remain unconfirmed 是 remain 加形容词化过去分词的结构，强调报道尚缺公司正式确认。

imitation.background_zh: 出差筹备：酒店预订仍待确认。
imitation.sentence_en: Our hotel reservation remains unconfirmed pending payment.
imitation.translation_zh: 我们的酒店预订仍未确认，尚待付款。

items.example: An equipment upgrade caused a failure that disrupted air travel across the United States.
items.analysis_zh: disrupt air travel 是常见新闻搭配，及物动词 disrupt 后直接接被干扰的正常运营活动。与 suspend flights 不同，disrupt 说明意外干扰，并不必然表示监管机构主动暂停所有航班。
items.cloze: An equipment upgrade caused a failure that ______ air travel across the United States.
items.why_zh: disrupt air travel 是常见新闻搭配，及物动词 disrupt 后直接接被干扰的正常运营活动。

imitation.background_zh: 生产计划：系统故障影响排产。
imitation.sentence_en: A system failure disrupted the production schedule.
imitation.translation_zh: 一次系统故障打乱了生产计划。

items.example: The transport secretary cautioned that flights might not return to normal until Monday.
items.analysis_zh: caution that 后接完整从句，表示发言者对恢复时间给出谨慎判断；might not 明确保留不确定性。与 promise 相比，caution 不构成恢复服务的保证。
items.cloze: The transport secretary ______ that flights might not return to normal until Monday.
items.why_zh: caution that 后接完整从句，表示发言者对恢复时间给出谨慎判断；might not 明确保留不确定性。

imitation.background_zh: 采购沟通：供应商提示交期可能延长。
imitation.sentence_en: The supplier cautioned that lead times might increase.
imitation.translation_zh: 供应商提醒说，交货周期可能延长。

items.example: Airlines faced a backlog of cancelled and delayed journeys after the communications system was repaired.
items.analysis_zh: a backlog of 加复数名词表示尚待处理的积压事项，常见于订单、维修工单及航班恢复场景。与 a delay 相比，backlog 强调累计存量；技术故障排除后，积压未必立即消失。
items.cloze: Airlines faced a ______ of cancelled and delayed journeys after the communications system was repaired.
items.why_zh: a backlog of 加复数名词表示尚待处理的积压事项，常见于订单、维修工单及航班恢复场景。

imitation.background_zh: 订单管理：介绍当前正在处理的积压。
imitation.sentence_en: We are clearing the backlog of purchase orders.
imitation.translation_zh: 我们正在清理积压的采购订单。

items.example: Iran described its drone attack on a US base in Bahrain as retaliation for earlier American strikes.
items.analysis_zh: retaliation for 是固定名词搭配，for 引出被声称作为报复对象的先前行动。described ... as 将这一因果解释归于伊朗方面，避免把单方说法直接当成独立核实的事实。与 revenge 相比，retaliation 更常用于国家间军事和贸易回应。
items.cloze: Iran described its drone attack on a US base in Bahrain as ______ for earlier American strikes.
items.why_zh: retaliation for 是固定名词搭配，for 引出被声称作为报复对象的先前行动。

imitation.background_zh: 财经写作练习：转述一方对关税措施的解释。
imitation.sentence_en: The government described the tariffs as retaliation for new trade restrictions.
imitation.translation_zh: 政府将这些关税描述为对新贸易限制的报复。

items.example: The latest attack could rekindle a conflict that Washington says it does not want to reopen.
items.analysis_zh: rekindle a conflict 是隐喻性动宾搭配，表示此前已有的冲突再次升温；could 明确标记风险尚未实现。与 trigger a conflict 相比，rekindle 更强调旧冲突的再次爆发。
items.cloze: The latest attack could ______ a conflict that Washington says it does not want to reopen.
items.why_zh: rekindle a conflict 是隐喻性动宾搭配，表示此前已有的冲突再次升温；could 明确标记风险尚未实现。

imitation.background_zh: 个人爱好：观看比赛后重新燃起篮球热情。
imitation.sentence_en: Watching the playoffs could rekindle my enthusiasm for basketball.
imitation.translation_zh: 观看季后赛可能重新点燃我对篮球的热情。

items.example: Houthi gains near a strategic strait may intensify pressure on international shipping.
items.analysis_zh: intensify pressure on something 是正式新闻表达，pressure on 引出承受压力的对象；may 表示潜在影响。与 create pressure 相比，intensify 通常暗示已有压力进一步增大。
items.cloze: Houthi gains near a strategic strait may ______ pressure on international shipping.
items.why_zh: intensify pressure on something 是正式新闻表达，pressure on 引出承受压力的对象；may 表示潜在影响。

imitation.background_zh: 国际物流：港口拥堵增加交付压力。
imitation.sentence_en: Port congestion may intensify pressure on delivery schedules.
imitation.translation_zh: 港口拥堵可能加大交付计划面临的压力。

items.example: Estonia announced that it would close its border with Russia from December 1st.
items.analysis_zh: close its border with Russia 是及物动词加宾语的搭配；would close 属于过去报道语境中的将来过去时，说明措施已经宣布、预定将来实施。与 has closed 不同，不能据此断言边境已经关闭。
items.cloze: Estonia announced that it would ______ its border with Russia from December 1st.
items.why_zh: close its border with Russia 是及物动词加宾语的搭配；would close 属于过去报道语境中的将来过去时，说明措施已经宣布、预定将来实施。

imitation.background_zh: 生产规划练习：转述工厂未来关闭产线的计划。
imitation.sentence_en: The factory announced that it would close a production line in December.
imitation.translation_zh: 工厂宣布将在十二月关闭一条产线。

items.example: The government accused Moscow of involvement in an attempted arson attack near Tallinn.
items.analysis_zh: accuse someone of something 是固定结构，of 后接名词或动名词。句子仅陈述爱沙尼亚政府的指控，并未独立证明莫斯科参与袭击。与 establish responsibility 相比，accuse 明确保留证据和归因的边界。
items.cloze: The government ______ Moscow of involvement in an attempted arson attack near Tallinn.
items.why_zh: accuse someone of something 是固定结构，of 后接名词或动名词。

imitation.background_zh: 合同纠纷练习：转述客户提出的指控。
imitation.sentence_en: The customer accused the contractor of breaching the agreement.
imitation.translation_zh: 客户指责承包商违反协议。

items.example: The prime minister said support for Ukraine would remain steadfast despite the alleged intimidation.
items.analysis_zh: remain steadfast 是系动词加形容词，强调在外部压力下仍坚持原有立场；despite 后面接名词短语。与 stubborn 相比，steadfast 常带有坚守承诺的积极语义。
items.cloze: The prime minister said support for Ukraine would remain ______ despite the alleged intimidation.
items.why_zh: remain steadfast 是系动词加形容词，强调在外部压力下仍坚持原有立场；despite 后面接名词短语。

imitation.background_zh: 品质管理：成本压力下维持质量承诺。
imitation.sentence_en: Our commitment to product quality remains steadfast despite cost pressure.
imitation.translation_zh: 尽管面临成本压力，我们对产品质量的承诺仍然坚定不移。

items.example: Shares in New World Development plunged after it announced a large rights issue.
items.analysis_zh: shares plunged 是财经新闻中的不及物动词用法，表示价格短时间大幅下跌。报道所述跌幅接近一半，plunged 比 edged down 或 slipped 更符合量级。after 引出公告与市场反应的先后关系。
items.cloze: Shares in New World Development ______ after it announced a large rights issue.
items.why_zh: shares plunged 是财经新闻中的不及物动词用法，表示价格短时间大幅下跌。

imitation.background_zh: 财经写作练习：描述盈利预警后的股价表现。
imitation.sentence_en: The stock plunged following a profit warning.
imitation.translation_zh: 发布盈利预警后，该股大幅下跌。

items.example: The proposed shares would be offered at a steep discount to the previous closing price.
items.analysis_zh: at a discount to the closing price 是股票发行定价的常见结构，to 引出比较基准。与 rebate 不同，discount 表示发行价低于参考市价，未必涉及事后返还。would be offered 说明这是拟议发行安排。
items.cloze: The proposed shares would be offered at a steep ______ to the previous closing price.
items.why_zh: at a discount to the closing price 是股票发行定价的常见结构，to 引出比较基准。

imitation.background_zh: 投资学习：讨论折价发行的定价方式。
imitation.sentence_en: The shares were offered at a discount to the previous closing price.
imitation.translation_zh: 这些股份以低于前一交易日收盘价的价格发行。

items.example: The announcement fuelled concerns about the indebted developer's financial position.
items.analysis_zh: fuel concerns about 是新闻英语中表示助长担忧的动宾搭配，concerns about 后接具体风险对象。与 cause concerns 相比，fuel 通常暗示担忧此前已经存在、如今进一步升温。
items.cloze: The announcement ______ concerns about the indebted developer's financial position.
items.why_zh: fuel concerns about 是新闻英语中表示助长担忧的动宾搭配，concerns about 后接具体风险对象。

imitation.background_zh: 供应商评估：延期使可靠性受到更多质疑。
imitation.sentence_en: Repeated delays fuelled concerns about supplier reliability.
imitation.translation_zh: 多次延期加剧了人们对供应商可靠性的担忧。

items.example: Anthropic is expected to float shares in an initial public offering this week.
items.analysis_zh: float shares 是英式财经英语，表示向公众发行股份并上市；is expected to 表明仍属预期。与 trade shares 不同，float 聚焦首次发行，不能据此认为股票已经开始交易。
items.cloze: Anthropic is expected to ______ shares in an initial public offering this week.
items.why_zh: float shares 是英式财经英语，表示向公众发行股份并上市；is expected to 表明仍属预期。

imitation.background_zh: 投资研究练习：讨论一家拟上市公司的融资计划。
imitation.sentence_en: The company plans to float a minority stake next year.
imitation.translation_zh: 该公司计划明年将少数股权公开发行上市。

items.example: The AI company is targeting a valuation of roughly $1.5 trillion.
items.analysis_zh: target a valuation of 加金额是投融资中的目标估值表达；is targeting 表示发行方目前的计划。与 achieve a valuation 相比，targeting 不意味着投资者已经接受这个价格。
items.cloze: The AI company is ______ a valuation of roughly $1.5 trillion.
items.why_zh: target a valuation of 加金额是投融资中的目标估值表达；is targeting 表示发行方目前的计划。

imitation.background_zh: 海外项目练习：在评审会上介绍盈利目标。
imitation.sentence_en: The localisation project is targeting a gross margin of 30%.
imitation.translation_zh: 这个本地化项目的目标毛利率为30%。

items.example: Investors will scrutinise its growth prospects as competition in AI coding tools intensifies.
items.analysis_zh: scrutinise growth prospects 是正式财经动宾搭配，强调对收入增长假设和商业模式作严格检视。as 引出竞争加剧的背景；与 glance at 相比，scrutinise 表示细致且带批判性的分析。
items.cloze: Investors will ______ its growth prospects as competition in AI coding tools intensifies.
items.why_zh: scrutinise growth prospects 是正式财经动宾搭配，强调对收入增长假设和商业模式作严格检视。

imitation.background_zh: 产能评估：承诺交期前审核供应商的测算依据。
imitation.sentence_en: We need to scrutinise the supplier's capacity assumptions before confirming the delivery schedule.
imitation.translation_zh: 我们需要仔细审查供应商的产能假设，再确认交付计划。

passages.title: Nvidia's leadership dispute
passages.body: The treasury secretary {{2026-11-16-nvidia-urged}} Nvidia to consider an outsider as its next chief executive. A campaign for Jensen Huang's return has {{2026-11-16-nvidia-gathered}} momentum among prominent technology executives. Reports of discussions with confidants remain {{2026-11-16-nvidia-unconfirmed}} by Nvidia, ahead of its earnings release.

passages.title: US aviation recovers from a communications failure
passages.body: An equipment upgrade caused a failure that {{2026-11-16-aviation-disrupted}} air travel across the United States. The transport secretary {{2026-11-16-aviation-cautioned}} that flights might not return to normal until Monday. Airlines faced a {{2026-11-16-aviation-backlog}} of cancelled and delayed journeys after the communications system was repaired.

passages.title: Strikes raise the risk of regional escalation
passages.body: Iran described its drone attack on a US base in Bahrain as {{2026-11-16-iran-retaliation}} for earlier American strikes. The latest attack could {{2026-11-16-iran-rekindle}} a conflict that Washington says it does not want to reopen. Houthi gains near a strategic strait may {{2026-11-16-iran-intensify}} pressure on international shipping.

passages.title: Estonia plans to shut its Russian border
passages.body: Estonia announced that it would {{2026-11-16-estonia-close}} its border with Russia from December 1st. The government {{2026-11-16-estonia-accused}} Moscow of involvement in an attempted arson attack near Tallinn. The prime minister said support for Ukraine would remain {{2026-11-16-estonia-steadfast}} despite the alleged intimidation.

passages.title: Hong Kong developer proposes a discounted share sale
passages.body: Shares in New World Development {{2026-11-16-property-plunged}} after it announced a large rights issue. The proposed shares would be offered at a steep {{2026-11-16-property-discount}} to the previous closing price. The announcement {{2026-11-16-property-fuelled}} concerns about the indebted developer's financial position.

passages.title: Anthropic prepares for a major stock-market debut
passages.body: Anthropic is expected to {{2026-11-16-anthropic-float}} shares in an initial public offering this week. The AI company is {{2026-11-16-anthropic-targeting}} a valuation of roughly $1.5 trillion. Investors will {{2026-11-16-anthropic-scrutinise}} its growth prospects as competition in AI coding tools intensifies.
